description.en: Don't let the serene, silver-grey exterior fool you; this little dreamer's mind is always among the stars. Just know that when he sits with the composure of a statue, his spirit is dancing with distant galaxies in a silent, magical observation. Take him on your nightly ventures, and he will transform an ordinary evening into an interstellar journey.
